data.one_liner: An expandable and animated floating search bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a persistent floating search bar widget that expands and animates between states. It supports custom transitions, query handling with debounce delays, and integration with scrollables to hide or show on scroll.
use_when: You want a persistent Google-style floating search bar in your app.
You need expandable search suggestions or animated transitions on search open and close.
avoid_when: You only need a static standard app bar search input field without floating or expansion animations.
You require complex search indexing or backend integration out of the box.
strengths: Smooth animations and built-in transitions like circular, expanding, and slide fade.
Customizable width, margins, actions, and scrolling behaviors.
Active continuation of a popular package with Flutter 3 support.
weaknesses: Requires careful handling of scrollable heights and shrink-wrapping unless isScrollControlled is used.
Not documented for non-Flutter platforms beyond mobile and desktop.
